new_packages.label: כְּבוֹד וְיִשְׂרָאֵל
new_packages.label_en: Glory and Israel — the Divine Garment
new_packages.rationale: The Torah opens with three chained bechina statements: (1) 'כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל נִקְרָא לְבוּשׁ' — every Israelite IS CALLED a garment; (2) 'וּלְבוּשׁ נִקְרָא כָּבוֹד' — the garment IS CALLED honor/glory; (3) 'כְּבוֹדִי הַיְנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל' — My glory IS Israel. All three use explicit bechina language (נִקְרָא, הַיְנוּ). The three concepts form a triangle: ישראל ↔ לבוש ↔ כבוד, each being an alternate expression of the same reality — the divine glory manifest through the people of Israel. The Rebbe's opening move is to establish why the world was created: because Israel = God's glory/garment, and God desired to have His glory manifest in the world. This cluster of concepts belongs to the domain of Israel's holy dignity and divine purpose — the theologically 'good' pole of the teaching.
source_quotes: נִמְצָא כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל נִקְרָא לְבוּשׁ, וּלְבוּשׁ נִקְרָא כָּבוֹד
וּכְבוֹדִי הַיְנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל, דִּכְתִיב: וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹכָם
new_packages.good_evil_mirror_note: No evil mirror for this cluster appears in the source text of Torah #94. However, line 5 describes the 'גָּלוּת' of divine speech ('הַדִּבּוּר עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּגָלוּת') — exile is implicitly the evil counterpart to the glory/garment cluster. When Israel is in exile, the garment-glory is in exile too, its light dimmed. This is the structural negative counterpart, though no explicit bechina edge equates any 'evil garment' or 'anti-glory' concept with another.

new_packages.label: נִיצוֹצוֹת וְאוֹתִיּוֹת
new_packages.label_en: Sparks and Letters — the Hidden Life-Force
new_packages.rationale: The teaching's central mechanism rests on three bechina equations about the nature of divine light hidden in created things: (1) 'הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת הֵם אוֹתִיּוֹת' — sparks ARE letters (line 6); (2) 'הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת הֵם הַחִיּוּת שֶׁל הַדָּבָר' — sparks ARE the vitality of the thing (line 12); (3) 'הָאוֹתִיּוֹת הֵם צִמְצוּמִים' — the letters ARE contractions/tzimtzumim (line 4). All three use 'הֵם' in a definitional equating context — classic bechina language. The four proposed nodes (ניצוצות, אותיות, חיות, צמצום) all share the same essential nature: they are different names for the compressed divine creative energy that God hid within every created thing when He formed the world through speech. The sparks ARE the letters ARE the vitality ARE the tzimtzum — they are four faces of one reality. This cluster is the conceptual heart of the Torah. Polarity: good — these are holy divine sparks, the Shekhinah hidden in material things.
source_quotes: וְהַנִּיצוֹצוֹת הֵם אוֹתִיּוֹת, נִמְצָא מַעֲלֶה אוֹתִיּוֹת
כִּי הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת הֵם הַחִיּוּת שֶׁל הַדָּבָר
וְהָאוֹתִיּוֹת הֵם צִמְצוּמִים, עַד כָּאן אוֹת א', עַד כָּאן אוֹת ת'
new_packages.good_evil_mirror_note: The evil counterpart of this cluster is implied in line 12: 'כְּשֶׁמַּעֲלֶה נִיצוֹצוֹת מֵהַדָּבָר, אֲזַי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה נַעֲשֶׂה אֶפֶס' — when the sparks are elevated, the thing becomes void (אֶפֶס). The 'אֶפֶס' / ארציות state — where the divine vitality is absent — is the negative pole. But no explicit evil-domain nodes are established via bechina language for this cluster in Torah #94.

new_packages.label: חָכְמָה וְעַיִן
new_packages.label_en: Wisdom and the Eye — the Pure Gaze
new_packages.rationale: The teaching's method for elevating sparks requires combining אמונה (Package 1) with חכמה. The wisdom cluster is defined by a chain of bechina equations: (1) 'וְ'דַע' הִיא הַחָכְמָה וְהַשֵּׂכֶל' — the imperative 'Know' IS wisdom (line 9); (2) 'וְחָכְמָה הִיא יוּ"ד' — wisdom IS the letter yod (line 9), proven by Rashi on 'יָשִׁיר' (the yod refers to thought/intellect); (3) 'הָעַיִן הוּא חָכְמָה' — the eye IS wisdom (line 10), proven by 'חַכְמֵי הָעֵדָה נִקְרָאִים עֵינֵי הָעֵדָה' (Numbers 15); (4) 'צִיץ — מִלְּשׁוֹן הִסְתַּכְּלוּת' — the tzitz IS gazing language (line 11). All six proposed nodes — חכמה, יוד, עין, דע, ציץ, הסתכלות — share the same essential nature: they are the intellectual gaze of wisdom that sees through the physical surface of things to the divine spark within. This is the epistemic faculty of the righteous person who can elevate sparks: he looks with the pure eye of wisdom. Note the geometric unification: the zayin (7) times the yod (10) equals ayin/70 — the Rebbe explicitly uses this gematria to show that faith (= zayin) combined with wisdom (= yod) produces the eye (= ayin). Polarity: good.
source_quotes: וְחָכְמָה הִיא יוּ"ד, כְּמוֹ שֶׁפֵּרֵשׁ רַשִׁ"י: יָשִׁיר — יוּ"ד עַל שֵׁם הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה נֶאֶמְרָה
הָעַיִן הוּא חָכְמָה, כִּי חַכְמֵי הָעֵדָה נִקְרָאִים עֵינֵי הָעֵדָה
וְעָשִׂיתָ צִּיץ זָהָב טָהוֹר, צִיץ — מִלְּשׁוֹן הִסְתַּכְּלוּת
new_packages.good_evil_mirror_note: This cluster has no explicit evil mirror in Torah #94. However, the teaching contrasts 'כְּשֶׁהוּא טָהוֹר כַּנַּ"ל, בֶּאֱמוּנָה וּבְחָכְמָה' — when the gaze is pure with faith and wisdom — against the implicit state of an impure/degraded gaze. An 'evil eye' concept is structurally implied but not named via bechina language in this Torah.
new_packages.relationship_to_package_1: Package 1 (אמונה ↔ אלקי אביך) and Package C (חכמה/עין) are connected via an eitza bridge: faith (Package 1) is combined with wisdom (Package C) to produce the ayin — this is an eitza relationship (faith + wisdom → eye that sees sparks), not a bechina identity between the two packages. The packages represent different domains (faith vs. intellectual sight) that the Torah instructs must be COMBINED — i.e., they flow together via eitza, confirming they are separate packages.

observations: Torah #94 is a severely under-represented teaching in the current dataset. Only 1 bechina edge exists (id 296), but the source text contains at least 11 explicit bechina-language equations spanning four distinct conceptual clusters: (A) כבוד/ישראל/לבוש — the theolgoical foundation (why worlds were created); (B) ניצוצות/אותיות/חיות/צמצום — the nature of divine light hidden in creation; (C) חכמה/יוד/עין/ציץ/הסתכלות — the faculty needed to elevate sparks; and the existing (D) אמונה/אלקי אביך — the specific quality that activates the faculty. The teaching's structure is: [כבוד/ישראל — why the world was created] → [ניצוצות hidden in everything] → [need to elevate them] → [method: אמונה + חכמה → עין that sees sparks → elevates them → produces speech → brings divine blessing]. Three of these four clusters are entirely absent from the dataset. Each of the three proposed new packages (A, B, C) contains 3 or more concepts connected by explicit bechina language, meeting the threshold for new package proposals. These are not marginal or ambiguous — they are the main conceptual building blocks of the Torah.
